summary.text: Cindy Myrex, a Republican, has represented District 12 in the Alabama House of Representatives since taking office on October 29, 2025, succeeding Corey Harbison.

paragraphs.text: She won the seat in a special general election on October 28, 2025, after winning a Republican primary runoff on August 12, 2025, and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.
